lines.en: There's something about hands that makes me uncomfortable, but I can't explain exactly what or why.
lines.zh: 手这种东西总让我不舒服，但我说不清到底是什么、为什么。

lines.en: Upon closer inspection, it might be the way each tendril can move on its own. How there are five creatures pushing themselves out of a center point that sends blood and nutrients to them.
lines.zh: 细看之下，也许是每一根触须都能各自活动的样子。像是五只生物从一个中心点挤出来，而那个中心点给它们输送血液和养分。

lines.en: That might not be the most accurate description in terms of anatomical function, but it's the one that makes the most sense to me and distracts me from what's actually happening right now.
lines.zh: 就解剖功能而言这大概算不上最准确的描述，但它对我来说最讲得通，也能让我不去管此刻真正在发生的事。

lines.en: Io inspects my hands. She focuses on the tendrils that have longed to penetrate her in ways that would make her vomit- and she does so with a smile.
lines.zh: Io 端详着我的手。她盯着那些曾渴望以会让她作呕的方式侵入她的触须——而她是笑着看的。

lines.en: She sees not their evil as they are divine in nature and easily camouflaged, but their mistaken beauty and a connection between us that is both fabricated and false.
lines.zh: 它们本质神圣又极易伪装，可她看见的不是其中的恶，而是那份错认的美，以及我们之间既被捏造又虚假的联结。

lines.en: Her hands are soft and only half the size of mine. I could crush them if I wanted to.
lines.zh: 她的手很软，只有我的一半大。只要我想，我就能把它们捏碎。

lines.en: I stay still and act as her voodoo doll, hoping the soft tracing of her tendrils upon my center point will send a signal to my brain that reminds me it's okay to love.
lines.zh: 我一动不动，当她的巫毒娃娃，盼着她柔软的触须在我中心点上描画时，能给大脑发送一个信号，提醒我「去爱是可以的」。

lines.en: But all I feel is the warmth of her skin and an immediate desire to go home and lie down.
lines.zh: 可我感受到的只有她皮肤的体温，以及一股立刻想回家躺下的冲动。

lines.en: So that is what I do.

lines.zh: Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!
